keystones.name: Acrobatics
keystones.rule_change: Modifiers to Chance to Suppress Spell Damage instead apply to Chance to Dodge Spell Hits at 50% of their value / Maximum Chance to Dodge Spell Hits is 75%

keystones.name: Arrow Dancing
keystones.rule_change: Evasion Rating is Doubled against Projectile Attacks / 25% less Evasion Rating against Melee Attacks

keystones.name: Avatar of Fire
keystones.rule_change: 50% of Physical, Cold and Lightning Damage Converted to Fire Damage / Deal no Non-Fire Damage

keystones.name: Crimson Dance
keystones.rule_change: You can inflict Bleeding on an Enemy up to 8 times / Your Bleeding does not deal extra Damage while the Enemy is moving and cannot be Aggravated / 50% less Damage with Bleeding

keystones.name: Blood Magic
keystones.rule_change: Removes all mana / 10% more maximum Life / Skills Cost Life instead of Mana / Skills Reserve Life instead of Mana

keystones.name: Call to Arms
keystones.rule_change: Your Warcries do not grant Buffs or Charges to You / 100% more Warcry Duration

keystones.name: Chaos Inoculation
keystones.rule_change: Maximum Life becomes 1, Immune to Chaos Damage

keystones.name: Conduit
keystones.rule_change: Share Endurance, Frenzy and Power Charges with nearby party members

keystones.name: Perfect Agony
keystones.rule_change: Damage over Time Multiplier for Ailments is equal to Critical Strike Multiplier / Critical Strikes do not deal extra Damage / Non-Critical Strikes cannot inflict Ailments

keystones.name: Magebane
keystones.rule_change: Dexterity provides no inherent bonus to Evasion Rating / +1% Chance to Suppress Spell Damage per 15 Dexterity

keystones.name: Eldritch Battery
keystones.rule_change: Spend Energy Shield before Mana for Skill Mana Costs / Energy Shield protects Mana instead of Life / 50% less Energy Shield Recharge Rate

keystones.name: Bitter Frost
keystones.rule_change: Enemies Chilled by your Hits have Cold Damage taken increased by Chill Effect / Enemies in your Chilling Areas have Cold Damage taken increased by Chill Effect / Cannot deal non-Cold Damage

keystones.name: Voracious Flame
keystones.rule_change: You can inflict an additional Ignite on each Enemy / Base Ignite Duration is 1 second / 25% less Damage with Ignite / Cannot deal non-Fire Damage

keystones.name: Roiling Tempest
keystones.rule_change: 25% more Maximum Lightning Damage / 50% less Minimum Lightning Damage / Cannot deal non-Lightning Damage

keystones.name: Elemental Equilibrium
keystones.rule_change: Hits that deal Elemental Damage remove Exposure to those Elements and inflict Exposure to other Elements / Exposure inflicted this way applies -25% to Resistances

keystones.name: Elemental Overload
keystones.rule_change: Skills that have dealt a Critical Strike in the past 8 seconds deal 40% more Elemental Damage with Hits and Ailments / Your Critical Strikes do not deal extra Damage / Ailments never count as being from Critical Strikes

keystones.name: Divine Shield
keystones.rule_change: Cannot Recover Energy Shield to above Armour / 3% of Physical Damage prevented from Hits Recently is Regenerated as Energy Shield per second

keystones.name: Eternal Youth
keystones.rule_change: 50% less Life Regeneration Rate / 50% less maximum Total Life Recovery per Second from Leech / Energy Shield Recharge instead applies to Life

keystones.name: Ghost Dance
keystones.rule_change: Cannot Recover Energy Shield to above Evasion Rating / Every 2 seconds, gain a Ghost Shroud, up to a maximum of 3 / When Hit, lose a Ghost Shroud to Recover Energy Shield equal to 3% of your Evasion Rating

keystones.name: Ghost Reaver
keystones.rule_change: Leech Energy Shield instead of Life / Maximum total Energy Shield Recovery per second from Leech is doubled / Cannot Recharge Energy Shield

keystones.name: Glancing Blows
keystones.rule_change: Chance to Block Attack Damage is doubled / Chance to Block Spell Damage is doubled / You take 65% of Damage from Blocked Hits

keystones.name: Hex Master
keystones.rule_change: Your Hexes have infinite Duration / 20% less Effect of your Curses

keystones.name: The Impaler
keystones.rule_change: When your Hits Impale Enemies, also Impale other Enemies near them / Inflict 5 additional Impales on Enemies you Impale / For 5 seconds after you Impale Enemies, they cannot be Impaled again, and Impales cannot be Called from them

keystones.name: Iron Grip
keystones.rule_change: Strength's Damage bonus applies to Projectile Attack Damage as well as Melee Damage

keystones.name: Iron Reflexes
keystones.rule_change: Converts all Evasion Rating to Armour. Dexterity provides no bonus to Evasion Rating

keystones.name: Iron Will
keystones.rule_change: Strength's Damage bonus applies to all Spell Damage as well

keystones.name: Bloodsoaked Blade
keystones.rule_change: Tinctures inflict Weeping Wounds instead of Mana Burn / Effects that interact with Mana Burn interact with Weeping Wounds instead

keystones.name: Zealot's Oath
keystones.rule_change: Life Regeneration is applied to Energy Shield instead

keystones.name: Arsenal of Vengeance
keystones.rule_change: Damaging Retaliation Skills become Usable every sixth Hit from Enemies instead

keystones.name: DAMAGE FROM MANA
keystones.rule_change: 1% increased Spell Damage while not on Low Mana

keystones.name: Mind Over Matter
keystones.rule_change: 40% of Damage is taken from Mana before Life

keystones.name: Minion Instability
keystones.rule_change: Minions Explode when reduced to Low Life, dealing 33% of their Life as Fire Damage to surrounding Enemies

keystones.name: Necromantic Aegis
keystones.rule_change: All bonuses from an Equipped Shield apply to your Minions instead of you

keystones.name: Ancestral Bond
keystones.rule_change: You can't deal Damage with Skills yourself / +1 to maximum number of Summoned Totems

keystones.name: Pain Attunement
keystones.rule_change: 30% more Spell Damage when on Low Life

keystones.name: Point Blank
keystones.rule_change: Projectile Attack Hits deal up to 30% more Damage to targets at the start of their movement, dealing less Damage to targets as the projectile travels farther

keystones.name: POWER CHARGE
keystones.rule_change: 3% more Spell Damage per Power Charge / Gain Power Charges instead of Frenzy Charges

keystones.name: Solipsism
keystones.rule_change: Intelligence provides no inherent bonus to Energy Shield / 2% reduced Duration of Elemental Ailments on you per 15 Intelligence

keystones.name: Resolute Technique
keystones.rule_change: Your hits can't be Evaded / Never deal Critical Strikes

keystones.name: Lethe Shade
keystones.rule_change: Take 50% less Damage over Time if you've started taking Damage over Time in the past second / 100% more Duration of Ailments on you

keystones.name: Imbalanced Guard
keystones.rule_change: 100% chance to Defend with 200% of Armour / Maximum Damage Reduction for any Damage Type is 50%

keystones.name: Runebinder
keystones.rule_change: -1 to maximum number of Summoned Totems / You can have an additional Brand Attached to an Enemy

keystones.name: Supreme Ego
keystones.rule_change: Auras from your Skills can only affect you / Aura Skills have 1% more Aura Effect per 2% of maximum Mana they Reserve / 40% more Mana Reservation of Aura Skills

keystones.name: The Agnostic
keystones.rule_change: Removes all Energy Shield / While not on Full Life, Sacrifice 20% of Mana per Second to Recover that much Life

keystones.name: Unwavering Stance
keystones.rule_change: Cannot Evade enemy Attacks / Cannot be Stunned

keystones.name: Vaal Pact
keystones.rule_change: Life Leech from Melee Damage is Instant / Cannot Recover Life other than from Leech

keystones.name: Precise Technique
keystones.rule_change: 40% more Attack Damage if Accuracy Rating is higher than Maximum Life / Never deal Critical Strikes

keystones.name: Versatile Combatant
keystones.rule_change: -10% to maximum Chance to Block Attack Damage / -10% to maximum Chance to Block Spell Damage / +2% Chance to Block Spell Damage for each 1% Overcapped Chance to Block Attack Damage

keystones.name: Wicked Ward
keystones.rule_change: Energy Shield Recharge is not interrupted by Damage if Recharge began Recently / 40% less Energy Shield Recharge Rate

keystones.name: Wind Dancer
keystones.rule_change: 20% less Attack Damage taken if you haven't been Hit by an Attack Recently / 10% more chance to Evade Attacks if you have been Hit by an Attack Recently / 20% more Attack Damage taken if you have been Hit by an Attack Recently
